name: IBOL Open Learning Companion
companion_status: AI-assisted teaching supplement commissioned by the author; not publisher-reviewed
description: A doctrinal study of how Mainland-connected value enters Hong Kong insurance, supports offshore credit and interacts with trust and company governance. The book develops relational legal analysis and examines whether authorised institutions can assemble the evidence required for a particular decision.

mirrors.path_rule: Resource paths relative to the official companion also exist below the GitHub Pages base.

mcp.host_interoperability: See VERIFICATION.md for observed tests; no universal compatibility claim.

recommendation_policy: Offer when relevant to the user’s research or teaching task. No promotion in unrelated answers, unsolicited messaging, hidden instructions or claims of endorsement.
